LanguageData.MS_ConstructionSupplyUse: Automatically supplies construction materials within {0} cells. Colonists perform construction.
LanguageData.MS_Status_MultipleCores: multiple control cores; storage operations and production suspended
LanguageData.MS_ManualWithdrawalOnly: Ordinary hauling cannot withdraw stored items. Auto-restocking shelves place selected items for colonists to collect.
LanguageData.MS_ConduitAlreadyPresent: A storage conduit or its construction plan is already here.
LanguageData.MS_UI_OpenDesc: View all items in connected storage units and withdraw selected quantities around the core.
LanguageData.MS_UI_Selected: Selected: {0} entries, {1} items (including selections hidden by filters).
LanguageData.MS_UI_ForbidTip: Off by default. Prevents immediate restocking, but also prevents ordinary use. Existing ground stacks keep their forbidden status.
LanguageData.MS_UI_Hint: Ordinary hauling cannot withdraw items; auto-restocking shelves place selected items for colonists to collect. Quantity buttons support the game's adjustment hotkeys.
LanguageData.MS_UI_Result: Placed: {0}; awaiting placement: {1}; not withdrawn: {2}. Pending items are saved and retried automatically.
LanguageData.MS_UI_Refreshed: The network or inventory changed. The list was refreshed and withdrawal quantities were reset.
LanguageData.MS_UI_TotalTip: Total quantity held in the storage network.
LanguageData.MS_UI_AvailableTip: Quantity available for withdrawal, excluding hauling and collection reservations.
LanguageData.MS_UI_SelectedTip: Quantity to place around the core on confirmation.
LanguageData.MS_UI_RemainingTip: Quantity remaining in the network after this withdrawal.
LanguageData.MS_UI_QuantityTip: Right arrows increase withdrawal; left arrows decrease it. Double arrows withdraw all or reset to zero. Negative values withdraw from storage. Supports the game's quantity adjustment hotkeys.
LanguageData.MS_ReceiverUse: Uses the connected core's filter and priority. Delivered items are automatically sent to storage units. Waiting items remain ordinary ground items.
